sensitivity.conductivity_diffusivity_note: Changing either conductivity or diffusivity changes k/kappa volumetric heat capacity consistently with the production parameter contract.
sensitivity.meaning: One parameter at a time at fixed factors; not a posterior or a model selection.

source.adaptation: Selected every complete age bin with 40 <= age <= 165 Ma, preserving all seven numeric columns. No model_outputs data imported.
source.attribution: Richards, F. D., Hoggard, M. J., Cowton, L. R., and White, N. J. (2018). Research data supporting Reassessing the Thermal Structure of Oceanic Lithosphere with Revised Global Inventories of Basement Depths and Heat Flow Measurements.
source.independence: Observations not used to fit the frozen synthetic W06 case. W06_COOLING.md records consultation of the method paper but no imported Earth calibration. Article section 2.2 explicitly avoids cooling-model-based observation culling.
source.limitations: Published sediment-corrected, spatially binned observations; quartiles represent dispersion, not confidence intervals. Correction uncertainty and correlations are not quantified here. Ages are bin centres; widths are not age errors. Selection avoids the young site-specific replacements and the article's >168 Ma spatial-bias exclusion.
source.locators: Section 2.2, Figure 3c and equation 17; archive README and member header.
